title: GAI MLE 661 Isobarometric Filler (2016)
description:
Overview

This GAI MLE 661 BIER is an isobarometric rinsing, filling and crown-capping monoblock for glass bottles, built in 2016 by GAI Macchine Imbottigliatrici S.p.A. (Ceresole d'Alba, Italy) and put into production in 2018.

The block combines rinsing, isobaric filling over 6 filling valves and crown capping in a single frame. It is set up for craft beer in 0.33 L, 0.5 L and 0.75 L glass bottles with crown caps in 26 mm and 29 mm. Cycle times, line speed and production counters are managed from the machine's touch panel. The machine is still installed and under power.

Technical data

  • Manufacturer: GAI Macchine Imbottigliatrici S.p.A. (Ceresole d'Alba, Italy)
  • Model: MLE 661 BIER (nameplate designation MLE661 BIER 003)
  • Year of manufacture: 2016 (in production since 2018)
  • Machine type: isobarometric rinser - filler - crown capper monoblock, glass bottles
  • Filling valves: 6
  • Capacity: up to 1,300 bph
  • Products: Beer and other carbonated beverages (isobarometric filling)
  • Bottle formats: 0.33 L / 0.5 L / 0.75 L glass
  • Crown caps: 26 mm and 29 mm
  • Control: touch panel with cycle-time, speed and production counters
  • Power supply: 6.38 kW
  • Air supply: 6 bar
  • Dimensions: approx. 480 x 130 x H 230 cm

Equipment

  • Format parts for the listed bottle formats and both crown sizes
  • Spare parts

Condition

Used - in production, still installed and under power. Approx. 6,800 operating hours; in December 2025 the machine counter showed 5,982 operating hours and approx. 6.25 million bottles filled. Last maintenance December 2025.

Availability

From 27 November 2026. Location: Croatia. The machine can be visited in production on request.
